d: What does it take to surprise gamers every time they drop in to play?

The Marketing Manager role in the UAE sits at the intersection of global vision and local insight, shaping how gaming experiences reach and resonate with MENA audiences. The challenge is to translate global priorities into campaigns that feel authentic and drive engagement across diverse markets.
In this role, you’ll turn local player feedback into the insight that guides future activations and partnerships, so every campaign connects with players in a meaningful way.
q: At least 5 years of experience in marketing, brand or publishing roles, ideally within gaming, entertainment or digital consumer brands
Proven ability to develop and execute go-to-market strategies tailored to the MENA region
Experience managing agencies, budgets and marketing programs, with an ability to keep accountability and manage performance
Exceptional communication, organisation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across teams and regions
Deep understanding of digital marketing channels, social platforms and creator ecosystems relevant to MENA audiences
Passion for gaming and digital culture, with sensitivity to cultural nuances and player behaviours across regions
Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in marketing or related subjects
Multi-market experience or multiple language fluency
r: Develop MENA regional marketing strategy and go-to-market plans that localise global priorities into market-specific, culturally sharp activations
Own MENA campaign planning and execution, shaping creative, messaging and go-to-market approach to drive awareness, engagement and player growth
Manage budgets, agencies and partnerships to ensure efficient resource allocation, accountability and measurable ROI across all channels
Serve as the regional connector across Communications, Creator Partnerships, Legal/Privacy and Platform teams to ensure campaign alignment, compliance and seamless execution
Act as the regional marketing lead, representing the voice of local players, aligning global and regional teams and translating market insights into future campaign planning
x: Annual air travel allowance for expatriates
Regular performance feedback and salary reviews
Global travel medical and accident insurance
Learning and development opportunities including in-house training and coaching, professional certifications, and courses

r: Develop the Reach Platform backend and its core capabilities across push notifications, SMS, email, WhatsApp, and other messaging channels. Own architecture design, feature development, performance optimization, reliability, and day-to-day operations for the delivery chain.

Build unified, reliable, efficient, and scalable messaging infrastructure for multiple sites and business lines. Core capabilities include message intake, task scheduling, user routing, channel selection, provider management, frequency limits and safeguards against erroneous sends, priority scheduling, delivery status callbacks, reporting, and effectiveness analysis. Ensure timely and reliable delivery at high volume and under high concurrency.

Improve platform reliability and observability through monitoring, alerts, logs, distributed tracing, and service level objectives (SLOs). Improve the speed of incident detection, diagnosis, and recovery. Plan capacity, run load tests, and optimize the system for large-scale campaigns, traffic spikes, and operational activities.

Collaborate with Product, Frontend, client engineering, QA, Data, Compliance, Security, Procurement, and third-party providers. Deliver compliant messaging capabilities across countries and regions, supporting marketing campaigns, trading alerts, security notifications, one-time passwords (OTPs), and system notifications. Provide stable, efficient, secure, and measurable messaging services for users worldwide.
